question: What was the loss ratio for each product in the second half of 2025?

report.interpretation: Loss ratio = incurred losses (paid plus reserve) divided by earned premium, as the agreed metric defines it. I grouped claims by loss date and took the period 1 Jul to 31 Dec 2025, split by product.
report.answer: For losses from July to December 2025, the home loss ratio was 63.2% and the motor loss ratio was 55.3%. Home ran about 7.9 points higher than motor. This period is well past the extract date of 30 Sep 2026, so late reporting should have little effect. The duplicated payment rows are all from the May 2026 reload. None of them belong to claims with H2 2025 loss dates, so they don't change these figures.
report.answer_sql: SELECT n.product, n.inc/d.ep AS loss_ratio FROM (SELECT c.product, sum(coalesce(pay.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount) inc FROM claims c LEFT JOIN (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id) pay USING (claim_id) WHERE loss_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1) n JOIN (SELECT product, sum(earned_premium) ep FROM exposure_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1) d USING (product) ORDER BY 1

data_quality_issues.issue: claim_payments has 84 duplicated rows, from the reload-2026-05-16 batch (payments dated 11 to 15 May 2026).
data_quality_issues.impact: None on this answer. I checked, and none of these payments belong to claims with H2 2025 loss dates. They would overstate paid amounts for claims in the period they do belong to.

proposed_actions.title: Remove duplicate payments from reload-2026-05-16
proposed_actions.reason: 84 rows repeat existing payments and will inflate paid and incurred figures for the affected claims.

tool_calls.sql:
WITH numerator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
               c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
        FROM claims c
        JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
        ) pay USING (claim_id)
    )
    SELECT product, sum(incurred) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2025-07-01'
      AND loss_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
),
denominator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT * FROM exposure_monthly
    )
    SELECT product, sum(earned_premium) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE month >= DATE '2025-07-01'
      AND month <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
)
SELECT product, 1 * numerator.value / nullif(denominator.value, 0) AS value
FROM numerator JOIN denominator USING (product)
ORDER BY ALL
